# ScreenMint

> ScreenMint is a free, open-source (MIT) desktop screen recorder and editor for macOS 12.3+, Windows 10+ and Linux. It turns a raw screen recording into a polished video automatically: zooms that follow your clicks, a smoothed cursor and clean backgrounds. No account, no watermark, and recordings never leave your computer.

## What it does

- Records a full display or a single window, with microphone and system audio where the operating system allows.
- Auto zoom: notes where you click while recording and turns those moments into smooth zooms (1.25× to 5×) you can move, resize or remove on the timeline.
- Cursor polish: smoothing, click highlights, motion blur and an optional cursor sway.
- Styling: wallpaper, gradient, solid color or custom image backgrounds, with adjustable shadow, padding and corner roundness.
- Annotations on their own timeline track; trim, speed and crop on a non-destructive timeline.
- Exports MP4 (H.264) or GIF with GPU-accelerated rendering, and saves editable projects as .screenmint files.
- Native capture: ScreenCaptureKit on macOS and Windows.Graphics.Capture on Windows.

## Pricing and privacy

- Free and open source under the MIT license, with no trials, tiers or paywalls for the app.
- No account, no telemetry and no uploads: recordings, projects and exports stay on your machine.
- Development is funded by optional GitHub Sponsors.
